transformations.description: Copies complete accepted Alicante StopNode and StopPlace objects exactly when numeric operator stop codes already exist in the accepted registry.
Uses the published numeric operator stop code as the stable suffix and creates one singleton StopPlace for every new code.
Stores all eight published Ida/Vuelta lists as independent directed patterns. No reverse pattern is inferred and closesLoop is false.
Appends exactly one catalog descriptor and recomputes all hashes from serialized bytes.

warnings: The supplied map defines a legacy route-family scope, while the available ordered stop lists and coordinates are current 2026 captures. This package does not claim a frozen historical timetable snapshot.

The legacy map labels line 12 as Plaza Luceros - Santo Domingo - San Blas - PAU I, while the current ordered source runs Puerta del Mar - San Blas - Plaza Juan Pablo II. The current order is stored and the disagreement is explicit.
Different numeric stop codes remain separate StopNodes and singleton StopPlaces even when names match or positions are close.
Accepted Alicante objects are retained complete-object exact even when current source labels differ.
StopNode.sourceReferences is empty because no genuine OpenStreetMap platform or stop_position evidence was used.
